title: gmaio comparison-assemblies samplesheet
description: One row per external pre-binned assembly. Genes are predicted (pyrodigal) and folded into the expanded gene catalogue for comparison purposes -- these assemblies are never binned. Sample IDs must not collide with the main samplesheet's or the comparison-reads samplesheet's sample IDs.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and contain no spaces

assembly.errorMessage: assembly must be a path to a FASTA of assembled contigs (.fasta / .fa, optionally .gz)
